base.recipe: Reconstruct supply(order,fixed,with_nodes=True), retain grades >= input_threshold in descending order, and allocate consecutive disjoint groups to recorded residues. A fixed root uses one input; a tail root uses q-1 in digit order 1,...,q-1. Fixed coordinates match the target residue; inner arrows have that target prefix. Finitize every tail occurrence with a distinct auxiliary prime > largest_prime, allocated by stage, residue, then preorder traversal. Gaps in guaranteed progressions are not asserted to miss expanded rows.

verification.gap_scope: Gap in guaranteed progressions; not a disproof of incidental coverage by expanded rows

recipe: Each source is a largest-prime tail with its recorded root inputs in digit order 1,...,q-1. Own fixed/tail nodes use the recorded target prefix. Borrowed digits reference the earlier source with that root prime and that digit; they add no new leaves. Finitize every own tail occurrence with a distinct auxiliary prime larger than largest_prime, allocated by base stages, sources, then preorder. Base and source exponent families are disjoint by largest-prime/exponent and the checked supply induction.

verification.gap_scope: Not an uncovered witness for all expanded congruences
